name: zc_mission_proof

tests.name: the mission subsystem holds the founder's seventeen, and says it is a preview
the orb stands where it was told, on the ground, clear of the Dog
every beat resolves to a real Julius phase, and names either its events or the gap
the chakra folds: holds through a handoff, falls back through a repair, crowns at the end
a new mission start drops the last task's colour back to root
only waiting, block and error ask for a person
every state was filmed in play, not just photographed
the orb is still readable somewhere else in the world
the orb costs under 10% of the frame (A/B, visible vs hidden)

idle.not_yet_emitted: Nothing reports that a finished run has been acknowledged and the world may rest. `run.completed` is the ENDING, which is what COMPLETE shows; going back to idle afterwards is a separate moment.

handoff.not_yet_emitted: Nothing reports work CHANGING HANDS. `architect.started`, `coder.started` and `review.started` report a role BEGINNING, which are three other beats; the interval between them is what this shows, and no event marks it.

approval_continue.not_yet_emitted: `task.paused` opens a human gate and nothing in the catalogue reports it being CLEARED. Binding this to `run.verified` was tried and removed: that is the run being verified, a different moment, and it would make the orb say a person approved when the run merely passed.
